item.title: Three Sounds from the Balcony
item.summary: A brother and sister listen from their balcony and try to find where three sounds come from.
item.content_markdown:
Dear Otabek,

Yesterday my sister and I played a game on our balcony. She wrote down the sounds we heard. I tried to say where each sound came from. First I heard a long, low sound. I thought it was a bus, but I saw a man close a heavy gate across the street.

Then we heard a short bell. My sister thought our phone was ringing. A woman on a bicycle went past. She rang the bell again when she came to the corner. We put “bicycle” on our list.

The last sound was like paper moving. We looked up and down the street. Then a small bird came out from behind the dry leaves in a pot on the balcony. It was right beside us. We both laughed. My sister wrote “our balcony” at the end of the list.

Your friend, Kamol

options: A plan to buy a bicycle
A game about finding where sounds come from
A phone call from his sister
questions.explanation: They listen, make guesses and find the source of three sounds.
Kamol sees a man close the heavy gate after hearing the low sound.

questions.prompt: What did the sister first think the bell was?
questions.explanation: The sister first thinks their phone is ringing.

questions.prompt: Why did the children laugh at the end?
options: Their list had fallen into the street.
They had looked away from a sound very close to them.
The woman lost her bell at the corner.
questions.explanation: They searched along the street, then found the bird right next to them on their own balcony.

questions.prompt: The sound like paper came from beside the children.
questions.explanation: The bird moved through leaves in a pot on their balcony.

questions.prompt: Kamol wrote down all the sounds himself.
The text says what colour the bicycle was.
questions.explanation: Kamol describes the bell and the rider but does not give the bicycle’s colour.
